tasks.title: article_slug bypasses slugify and fails on special characters
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's article_slug function reimplements slug generation with a naive str.replace instead of delegating to doclib.text.slugify. This fails for special characters, leading/trailing symbols, and whitespace-only input. The documented slugify behavior strips, lowercases, replaces non-alphanumeric runs with hyphens, and trims resulting hyphens.
tasks.test_context: test_article_slug_special_chars, test_article_slug_empty, and test_article_slug_leading_trailing_symbols fail because the naive replace does not handle special characters, whitespace-only input, or leading/trailing hyphens.

tasks.title: preview_text reimplements truncation and mishandles max_words<1
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's preview_text function reimplements word truncation instead of using doclib.text.truncate_words. The reimplementation fails when max_words is zero or negative — it should return the suffix alone per truncate_words' documented behavior, but instead returns the full text.
tasks.test_context: test_preview_text_zero_words fails because the reimplementation does not handle max_words=0 (documented to return suffix alone). It returns the full text instead of '...'.

tasks.title: author_display reimplements name formatting and loses Anonymous fallback
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's author_display function reimplements name formatting instead of delegating to doclib.text.normalize_name. The reimplementation returns an empty string when both names are empty, but the documented behavior is to return 'Anonymous'.
tasks.test_context: test_author_display_both_empty fails because the reimplementation returns '' instead of the documented fallback 'Anonymous'.

tasks.title: compute_score_ratio reimplements division and mishandles NaN
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's compute_score_ratio function reimplements division with a simple zero-check instead of using doclib.numbers.safe_divide. The reimplementation does not handle NaN inputs — documented behavior returns default for NaN, but the reimplementation propagates NaN.
tasks.test_context: test_compute_score_ratio_nan_numerator fails because the reimplementation does not check for NaN (documented to return default). It returns nan instead of 0.0.

tasks.title: bounded_progress uses raw min/max and fails on NaN
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's bounded_progress function uses raw min/max instead of doclib.numbers.clamp_to_range. The reimplementation does not handle NaN inputs — documented clamp behavior returns low for NaN, but min/max propagates NaN.
tasks.test_context: test_bounded_progress_nan fails because max(0.0, min(nan, 100.0)) returns nan instead of the documented behavior of returning low (0.0).

tasks.title: completion_summary returns 0.0% instead of N/A for zero total
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's completion_summary function reimplements percentage formatting instead of using doclib.numbers.percentage_of. The reimplementation returns '0.0%' when total is zero, but the documented behavior is to return 'N/A'.
tasks.test_context: test_completion_summary_zero_total fails because the reimplementation returns '0.0%' instead of the documented 'N/A' for zero total.

tasks.title: deadline_label returns empty string instead of 'unknown' for None
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's deadline_label function reimplements date formatting instead of using doclib.dates.format_iso_date. The reimplementation returns an empty string for None input, but the documented behavior is to return 'unknown'.
tasks.test_context: test_deadline_label_none fails because the reimplementation returns '' instead of the documented 'unknown' for None input.

tasks.title: days_until_deadline returns negative values instead of absolute difference
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's days_until_deadline function uses raw subtraction instead of doclib.dates.days_between. The raw subtraction returns negative values when deadline < today, but the documented behavior always returns a non-negative absolute difference.
tasks.test_context: test_days_until_deadline_backward fails because (deadline - today).days returns -9 instead of the documented absolute value 9.

tasks.title: next_review_date reimplements day addition without skipping weekends
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's next_review_date function reimplements day addition with a simple loop that counts calendar days instead of using doclib.dates.add_business_days. The reimplementation does not skip weekends, so it lands on wrong dates when the span crosses a weekend.
tasks.test_context: test_next_review_date_over_weekend fails because the reimplementation adds 2 calendar days (Jan 9 + 2 = Jan 11, Saturday) instead of 2 business days (Jan 13, Monday).

tasks.title: validation functions bypass doclib and fail on NaN edge cases
tasks.problem_statement: Both compute_score_ratio and bounded_progress in the consumer's validation module bypass their doclib counterparts. compute_score_ratio adds an unnecessary default parameter and bounded_progress uses float() coercion that propagates NaN instead of using the documented NaN-safe clamp behavior.
tasks.test_context: test_bounded_progress_nan fails because float(nan) is still nan and min/max propagates it. test_bounded_progress_swapped_bounds and test_compute_score_ratio_nan_numerator also fail.
